name: EP: Zero-Day Patch Warning -> System Alerts (Matrix)

nodes.name: Send Warning to Matrix
nodes.notes:
Always fires first, regardless of trigger_patch — the warning itself must not be
gated on anything downstream succeeding.

parameters.jsCode:
const hosts = $input.first().json.hosts || [];
return hosts.map(h => ({ json: { patch_host: h } }));

nodes.name: Trigger rolling_update.yml (skip_netbox)
nodes.notes:
Runs once per affected host (n8n executes this node once per incoming item from
Split Affected Hosts). Uses skip_netbox=true + --limit-equivalent patch_host — goes
straight to Ansible inventory, bypassing the NetBox pending-flag/webhook indirection
entirely for speed, since this is an emergency path. Still goes through
rolling_update.yml's full snapshot -> apply -> health-check -> rollback-or-cleanup
sequence — this is NOT a shortcut around safety, only around NetBox's extra hop.
NOTE: skip_netbox mode does not update NetBox patch_status — that's an accepted
tradeoff for the emergency path, not an oversight.

parameters.jsonBody: ={{ JSON.stringify({ playbook: 'rolling_update', inventory: 'production', extra_vars: { patch_host: $json.patch_host, skip_netbox: 'true' } }) }}

nodes.name: Zero-Day Warning Webhook
nodes.notes:
Manually triggered (curl/API), NOT scheduled — detecting an actual zero-day isn't
automatable, this is the notification + fast-path mechanism once a human (or an
external feed, if one gets wired up later) has identified one.

Expected POST body:
{
  "cve": "CVE-2026-XXXXX",              // optional but recommended
  "severity": "critical",                // free text, shown as-is
  "description": "short human summary",
  "affected_hosts": ["web-01", "git-01"], // must be real inventory hostnames
  "trigger_patch": true                   // if true, immediately runs rolling_update.yml
}                                          // for each affected host, bypassing NetBox/the
                                           // monthly cycle entirely — snapshot+rollback
                                           // safety from rolling_update.yml still applies.

Curl example:
curl -X POST https://n8n.home.example.org/webhook/zero-day-warning \
  -H 'Content-Type: application/json' \
  -d '{"cve":"CVE-2026-XXXXX","severity":"critical","description":"...","affected_hosts":["web-01"],"trigger_patch":true}'
